name: Entity Reference Deck Paragraphs
description: Paragraphs host: opt-in deck FieldWidget and list chrome for closed paragraph rows.
project_description: Host submodule of Entity Reference Deck for Paragraphs. Provides the 'entity_reference_deck_paragraphs' field widget (EntityReferenceDeckParagraphsWidget, extends the stable ParagraphsWidget) that renders closed paragraph rows as deck cards via EntityReferenceDeckCardBuilder without reimplementing add/drag/AJAX; closed_mode is locked to 'preview'. It decorates the card type presentation (ParagraphsCardTypePresentation, using ParagraphsType::getIconUrl() for icons), supplies a ParagraphPreviewProvider and a ParagraphPreviewSnapshot service, and acts as the preview host adapter (maps widget show_preview to context withShowPreview, passes the in-form paragraph and unsaved-changes signal). Requires Paragraphs and Entity Reference Revisions.
